senses.gloss: pr. n. (v. מֵישָׁא I) Meshan, Mesene, the island formed by the Euphrates, the Tigris and the Royal Canal. Kil. 49ᵇ תשעה נטלה מ׳ nine measures (of impudence) M. has carried off. Ib. 71ᵇ, a. e. מֵישׁוֹן מיתה M. is dead (for purity of descent), v. גּוֹסֵס.
units: Yoma 10ᵃ (expl. רחבת עיר, Gen. X, 11) פרת דמ׳ Perath Meshan (v. Berl. Beitr. z. Geogr., p. 44).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97b:1">B. Kam. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>יכול … הוציאו במ׳</he> he may say to him, pass it (the repealed coin) in Mesene.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73a:7">B. Bath. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>דמיאשן</he>; <cite ref="Shabbat 101a:2">Sabb. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>דמיש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00687"><he>בִּיצִּיתָא</he></cite>.
